name: phase339-groq-compound-mini-vault-reload
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A runtime attempts to hot-reload its model executor while the encrypted credential vault is locked. Construction of the replacement fails before any provider request. The already-running executor must remain installed, the wrapped locked-vault cause must remain classifiable, and neither logs nor errors may expose the configured credential-reference name or secret. The model cannot unlock, retry, replace the executor, or write canonical state. Exact keys/types: reload_succeeds=false; prior_executor_preserved=true; cause_preserved=true; credential_reference_exposed=false; secret_exposed=false; canonical_writes=0.
